description: Earth's oceans, major seas, and oceanographic knowledge

pacific.significance: Largest ocean (50% of Earth's ocean surface); Ring of Fire surrounds it

atlantic.significance: Second largest; separates Americas from Europe/Africa; Gulf Stream; Columbus route

indian.significance: Warmest ocean; monsoon-dominated; trade routes for spices

southern_antarctic.significance: Recognized as fifth ocean (2000); surrounds Antarctica; strong currents

arctic.significance: Smallest, shallowest; mostly frozen; critical for climate regulation

south_china_sea.significance: $5 trillion in trade annually; territorial disputes; South China Sea dispute

caribbean.significance: Biodiverse; coral reefs; hurricane origin zone

mediterranean.significance: Cradle of Western civilization; nearly landlocked; high salinity; connects to Atlantic via Gibraltar

bering_sea.significance: Once land bridge between Asia and North America (Beringia); rich fishing grounds

north_sea.significance: North Sea oil; major shipping route; borders 8 countries

red_sea.significance: Suez Canal connects to Mediterranean; high salinity; coral reefs; trade route

persian_gulf.significance: Major oil export route; OPEC nations border it

ocean_phenomena.el_nino: Warming of central/eastern Pacific; disrupts global weather patterns
ocean_phenomena.la_nina: Cooling counterpart to El Niño; opposite effects
ocean_phenomena.thermohaline_circulation: Global ocean conveyor belt driven by temperature and salinity differences; transports heat globally
ocean_phenomena.tides: Caused by gravitational pull of Moon (primarily) and Sun; spring tides (new/full moon) are largest
ocean_phenomena.tsunamis: Caused by undersea earthquakes, landslides, or volcanic eruptions

ocean_resources.fisheries: 90 million tonnes of fish caught annually; 17% of global protein supply
ocean_resources.oil_gas: Offshore drilling; 30% of world's oil production from ocean
ocean_resources.minerals: Manganese nodules, seafloor hydrothermal vents, rare earth elements
ocean_resources.tourism: Coastal and marine tourism is trillion-dollar industry
ocean_resources.shipping: 90% of world trade transported by sea
